title: com.enroll arguments: take a Project's responder slot for a capability (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: The responder is the authenticated session; a supplied process id, model name, origin, launcher label or descriptor never authorizes it. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments). Any participant reply of the request's target Project moves a queued request to answered, whatever the slot's state, so a session whose com.enroll is refused, whatever the refusal, does no work on the request and reads the slot in com.status: active, it leaves the request to that holder and asks no one; stale, absent at a later generation, or no generation shown, it sends no reply, leaves the request to that service and asks the operator; absent at generation 0 (no service ever held it), one session replies once that it cannot take the request now, why and what would lift it. A session that enrolls answers each request it claims in the same turn by a com.progress note or a fenced reply carrying the state, and settles it with com.accept, then com.complete (DEC-0152 SA-2, SA-6).

capability.description: A capability of the caller's Project; the slot's Project comes from the endpoint, and the host's responder grant for it is checked in the same statement.
